title: The Dragon-Hatching Feast
description: A royal feast to celebrate the hatching of dragon eggs, ended by King Baelenys collapsing from poison and the Red Keep locked down in suspicion.

title: Wedding at Driftmark
description: The Velaryon seat of High Tide hosts a grand wedding, drawing half the nobility of the eastern coast to Driftmark's harbor.

title: The Massacre at Oldtown
description: Prince Gaelor's vanguard clashes with Oldtown's knights in the castle courtyard — a slaughter the Citadel and the Reach will remember for a hundred years.

title: The Grand Tourney at King's Landing
description: A grand tourney meant to lift the city's spirits ends instead in bloodshed and scandal — an assassination attempt on Prince Gaelor by a disguised Oldtown survivor, and a brutal, inconclusive final tilt between the two Targaryen princes that leaves neither able to stand.

title: The Trial of Ser Brant Costayne
description: Ser Brant Costayne stands trial in the Great Hall of the Red Keep before the Hand of the King, the Grand Maester, and the High Septon. The panel sentences him to the Wall — a verdict he immediately voids by demanding trial by combat.
